contents.text: How much oil does an HG-400 take at an oil change, and which grade?
An HG-400 gearbox is filled with 18 liters of ISO VG 220 mineral gear oil at the factory. The oil grade for an HG-400 gearbox is ISO VG 220.

HG-400 Helical Gearbox Operating Manual › 4 Lubrication › 4.1 Lubrication
The HG-400 is filled at the factory with 18 liters of ISO VG 220 mineral gear oil.
Change the oil after the first 500 operating hours, then every 5,000 operating hours or every 12 months, whichever comes first.
Check the oil level weekly at the sight glass with the gearbox stopped.
In operation, the oil temperature must not exceed 90 °C.
## 4.2 Approved oils
Table 4-1 Approved oils
| Oil type | Viscosity grade | Change interval |
|---|---|---|
| Mineral gear oil | ISO VG 220 | 5,000 h or 12 months |
| Synthetic PAO gear oil | ISO VG 220 | 10,000 h or 24 months |
| Food-grade gear oil (NSF H1) | ISO VG 220 | 5,000 h or 12 months |
When changing from one type to the other, flush the gearbox with the new oil first.

SOP-MS-003: Oil change on HG-400 gearboxes
# SOP-MS-003: Oil change on HG-400 gearboxes
This procedure applies the oil change in section 4.3 of the HG-400 manual at Contoso plants and adds the checks that the plants' oil analysis program needs.
4. Refill with ISO VG 220 oil of the type on the gearbox's lubrication label: 18 liters for an HG-400.
Gearbox GBX-07 on the Lakeside packaging line runs on synthetic PAO oil, so its change interval is 10,000 hours.

Field service report SR-2026-1213
Complaint: a whining noise from the HG-400 gearbox that rose with speed.
Findings: the oil level was below the sight glass and the oil had darkened; the last oil change was 14 months earlier.
Work done: drained and flushed the gearbox, refilled it with 18 liters of ISO VG 220 oil and replaced a leaking output shaft seal.
Recommended an oil analysis every six months.

| HG-400 gearbox | Woodgrove Foods, Packaging line 2 | SR-2026-1213 |
